title: Welder
what: Joins and shapes metal for submarines, nuclear plant and manufacturing supply chains.

title: Machinist
what: Operates precision machinery to make parts for defence and manufacturing employers.

title: Electrical/electronics engineer
what: Designs, builds and maintains electrical systems for manufacturing and defence sites.

title: Engineering fitter
what: Assembles and fits mechanical components for advanced manufacturing employers.

title: Nuclear systems engineer
what: Designs and manages complex nuclear engineering systems, including via the STAND-Up doctoral programme.

title: Groundworker
what: Prepares sites and lays foundations for new building projects.

title: Electrician
what: Installs and maintains electrical systems on construction sites and in buildings.

title: Civil engineering technician
what: Supports the design and delivery of roads, ports and infrastructure projects.

title: Construction site supervisor
what: Oversees day-to-day work and safety on construction sites.

title: Quantity surveyor
what: Manages the costs and contracts of construction projects.

title: Heating engineer
what: Installs and maintains heat pumps, boilers and other low-carbon heating systems.

title: Solar PV installer
what: Installs solar panels and other renewable energy equipment.

title: Pipe and plate welder
what: Welds pipework and structures for energy and nuclear sites.

title: Engineering technician
what: Maintains and operates equipment on energy and clean power sites.

title: SMR operations engineer
what: Operates and maintains small modular nuclear reactors as new nuclear projects come online.

title: Care and support worker
level: Level 2 apprenticeship or Adult Social Care Certificate
what: Supports people with daily living in care homes or in their own homes.

title: Care manager
what: Leads a care team and manages the quality of care in a setting.

title: Nurse
what: Provides clinical care in hospitals, care homes or the community.

title: Social worker
what: Supports vulnerable children, adults and families to stay safe and well.

title: Countryside worker
what: Carries out practical conservation and land management work, often with LANSS and Kendal College.

title: Agricultural/farm technician
what: Works on farms adapting to new technology, nature-friendly farming and diversification.

title: Forestry worker
what: Manages woodland, from timber production to the Woodland Carbon Code and agroforestry.

title: Professional forester
what: Plans and manages forests and woodland at a professional level, via the University of Cumbria's programme.

title: Land-based business/environmental adviser
what: Advises land-based businesses on grants, diversification and nature recovery.

title: Commis chef / chef de partie
what: Trains in a professional kitchen, working towards more senior chef roles.

title: Hospitality team member
what: Works front of house or in food and beverage service in hotels, pubs and restaurants.

title: Housekeeping/accommodation services assistant
what: Keeps guest accommodation clean, safe and welcoming.

title: Travel and tourism officer
what: Helps plan and promote trips, attractions and visitor experiences.

title: Hospitality manager
what: Manages teams, budgets and guest experience in hotels, restaurants and attractions.
